verdict.rationale: New Relic ships a dedicated CLI (newrelic-cli) for entity search, deployment markers, tags, and workloads, plus a GraphQL API (NerdGraph) and Terraform provider for agent/config management—all of which are scriptable and CI-friendly, and deployment markers are a canonical CI/CD automation use case. There's also a diagnostics CLI (nrdiag) for automated checks. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions workflow snippets) and independent hands-on confirmation that these tools run reliably headlessly in real automation pipelines.
